_Documentation._purpose: JSON does not support comments, so this sibling key documents the Slack configuration schema. Bound options classes ignore unknown keys, so the entire _Documentation object is dropped on load.
_Documentation.Workspaces: Array of SlackWorkspaceSeedEntry. Fields: TeamId (string, Slack team_id, required), WorkspaceName (string), BotTokenSecretRef (string, ISecretProvider key for the bot OAuth token -- secrets are NEVER inlined), SigningSecretRef (string, required, ISecretProvider key for the HMAC signing secret), AppLevelTokenRef (string|null, only for Socket Mode workspaces), DefaultChannelId (string), FallbackChannelId (string|null), AllowedChannelIds (string[], Stage 3.2 ACL gate -- empty rejects all channels), AllowedUserGroupIds (string[]), Enabled (bool, default true).
_Documentation.InboundEventBuffer: Bounded in-process queue SlackConnector.ReceiveAsync drains. Capacity (int, default 1024 -- see InMemorySlackInboundEventBuffer.DefaultCapacity) caps the buffered HumanDecisionEvent count. OverflowPolicy (string) selects the back-pressure behaviour applied at capacity: DropNewest (default, iter-3 fix) rejects the incoming event so the OLDEST never-drained events are preserved -- a stalled poller eventually surfaces them after catching up; DropOldest evicts the head ring-buffer style so the newest event wins; Reject increments the drop counter without throwing (functionally identical to DropNewest for the in-memory implementation). The audit log (slack_audit_entry) remains the authoritative copy of every event regardless of policy, so a drop is recoverable through the audit query API.
_Documentation.SocketMode: Stage 4.2 Socket Mode WebSocket transport knobs (SlackSocketModeOptions). Bound by AddSlackSocketModeTransport(IConfiguration), which the AddSlackMessenger facade now invokes automatically (iter-4 fix). Fields: InitialReconnectDelay (TimeSpan, default 00:00:01) first reconnect attempt delay; MaxReconnectDelay (TimeSpan, default 00:00:30) upper bound on the exponential-backoff-with-jitter reconnect delay -- matches architecture.md §2.2.3; AckTimeout (TimeSpan, default 00:00:04) per-envelope ACK write deadline on the WebSocket, kept tighter than Slack's 5-second envelope-ACK budget (tech-spec.md §5.2) so a stuck socket fails fast and triggers reconnection; ReceiveBufferSize (int bytes, default 16384) per-connection receive buffer for text-frame assembly. Misconfigurations (ReceiveBufferSize <= 0, InitialReconnectDelay > MaxReconnectDelay, non-positive AckTimeout) fail the host at boot via SlackSocketModeOptionsValidator + ValidateOnStart.
_Documentation.SecretProvider: ProviderType ∈ {Environment, KeyVault, InMemory}. RefreshIntervalMinutes is the cache TTL for resolved secrets.
_Documentation.ConnectionStrings:SlackAudit: EF Core connection string for SlackPersistenceDbContext. Defaults to SQLite (Data Source=slack-audit.db); production hosts override with a managed-database connection string.
